acc_welcome_desc: First tell us who you are. After that you can complete your profile.
acc_name_hint: Write your name exactly as it is on your ID. You can write it only once, so check it before you save.
acc_now_password: Your email is confirmed. Now choose your new password.
acc_now_email: Your password is changed. Now add your own email.
ga_step1: The organization gives you a slip with your login email and password at the welcome event.
ga_step2: Sign in with that email and password.
ga_step3: Write your name and complete your profile.
ga_step4: Within a few weeks, add your own real email (confirmed with a code) and choose a new password.
ga_sub: Accounts are given by the organization. You do not create one yourself.
ga_lost: No slip yet, or you lost it? Ask the organization for a new one.
get_account_link: How do I get an account?
adm_exp_users_d: Every account with its roles, year, department, stage and whether it came from a slip. No passwords.
adm_exp_groups_d: Groups with their admin, members and the groups students chose (three sheets).
adm_exp_courses_d: Curriculums, semester courses, enrolments, class days and all course attendance (five sheets).
adm_exp_pubqa_d: Public questions and their answers with approval status.
adm_exp_materials_d: Uploaded course and group materials with who added them.
adm_exp_setup_d: Departments, the yearly promotion history and the slip registration batches (three sheets).
adm_exp_sms_d: The latest 5000 SMS messages with their status.
adm_exp_all_d: One Excel file with every table above, one sheet each. Use it as a backup copy. Contains personal information: keep it safe.
login_email_invalid: This does not look like an email address. Check it, for example name@example.com.
login_wrong: Incorrect email or password. Your account is given by the organization on a printed slip.
slip_on_slip: Named, still on the slip email
slip_needs_password: Real email set, password not changed
slip_hint: Each student is in one step. Press a number to see those students. After the deadline, students who are not finished are locked out until they finish.
acc_replace_pw: Your email is confirmed. For your safety the password on the slip must go now: choose your own new password to continue.
att_no_target: Open this page from an event or a class day.
att_close_confirm: Close attendance? Scanning stops. When the event is over, everyone not checked in is saved as absent.
att_closed_early_toast: Scanning stopped. People not marked are saved as absent when the event is over.
att_auto_close: Closes by itself at {{when}} if you forget.
att_camera_failed: The camera could not start. Type the badge text below, or let the students type the room code.
att_point_camera: Point the camera at a student's badge.
att_queued: Saved on this phone. It will be sent when the network is back.
att_queue_hint: Without network, scans are kept on this phone and sent later.
att_sync_failed: Still no connection. The scans are kept.
att_code_hint: Show this on a screen. Students open Finot > Check in and scan it or type the code.
att_code_failed: Cannot reach the server for the code. Scan badges instead.
att_helpers_hint: Helpers may scan badges for this session from their own phone (Finot > Check in > Scan for the organizer). Tick them.
att_err_bad_badge: This is not a Finot badge.
att_err_old_badge: This badge is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
att_err_not_on_roster: This student is not on the list for this session.
att_err_closed: Attendance is closed for this session.
att_err_not_yet: Attendance opens one hour before the event starts.
att_err_ended: This event has ended. Correct it with Mark attendance on the website.
att_err_wrong_code: Wrong or expired code. Read the screen again.
att_err_forbidden: You may not take attendance here.
att_err_another_open: Another session is already open for this.
badge_desc: Show this QR at the door; the organizer scans it and you are marked present.
badge_keep: Save it as a picture or print it. It works without internet. Do not share it: it is your own.
badge_failed: The badge could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
checkin_desc: Scan the code on the organizer's screen, or type the 6 digits.
checkin_none: Nothing to check in to right now
checkin_none_desc: When an organizer opens attendance for one of your events or classes, it appears here.
checkin_badge_hint: You can also show your badge at the door.
checkin_recorded_desc: You are marked present. Nothing more to do.
checkin_camera_failed: The camera could not start. Type the 6 digits instead.
checkin_too_many: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
checkin_helper_hint: Helping at the door? Open the organizer's scanner:
adm_messages_desc: Emails and text messages the system sends to the community.
adm_email_desc: Event announcements and "event tomorrow" reminders wait in an outbox and go out in daily portions, nearest event first. The free email plan allows about 300 a day.
adm_email_limit_hint: At most this many emails go out per day. Emails over the limit wait for the next day.
adm_email_send_started: Sending started. Refresh this page in a minute.
adm_email_retried: {{n}} email(s) are back in the queue.
adm_todo_emails: {{n}} email(s) could not be sent. Open Messages to retry.
badge_reissue_confirm: Give {{name}} a new attendance badge? The old badge picture stops working; they open My badge again to get the new one.
badge_reissued: New badge made. The old one no longer scans.
ins_counts_course: Present and absent per class day
ins_no_data: No attendance taken yet. The charts appear after the first one.
ins_no_next_day: No planned class day without attendance.
ins_expected_hint: The average of the last {{n}} events with attendance, applied to this event's list.
ins_expected_hint_course: The average of the last {{n}} class days with attendance, applied to the enrolled students.
ins_no_estimate: No estimate yet: take attendance a few times first.
ins_at_risk_desc: On the list but not present at any of the last {{n}} events with attendance.
ins_at_risk_desc_course: Enrolled but not present at any of the last {{n}} class days with attendance.
ins_at_risk_none: Nobody. Everyone came at least once.
ins_no_data_me: Nothing recorded in the last 6 months.
ins_streak: Present at the last {{n}} events in a row
adm_email_notice: Notice at the top of every email
adm_email_notice_hint: While this box is not empty, every email starts with this text in a yellow box. Use it while testing, for example: "This is only a test of the Finot platform. Please ignore it, and thank you for your patience." Clear it when you go live.
adm_email_notice_off: No notice: emails go out as normal.
usr_identity_hint: Fix what was typed wrongly on the slip. A new login email works at once, without a code; tell the person.
dep_stage: A stage before the final department
dep_stage_hint: Tick for Pre-Science, Pre-Engineering or a school: a student on it chooses again later. A stage has no length of its own: the longest program it leads to counts.
dep_leads_to_hint: What a student on this stage may choose next. Leave all unticked to allow any department.
prof_stage_pick: Choose your next stage or department
prof_stage_hint: You are in {{stage}}. When your next stage or department is known, choose it here; the final department is set once.
prof_stage_banner: You are in {{stage}}. Once your next stage or department is known, choose it on your profile.
prof_year_banner: Choose your year of study and your department. You can choose them only once; after that only the Super Admin can change them.
yc_intro: First choose your year of study and your department. You can choose them only once; after that only the Super Admin can change them.
yc_year1_hint: In year 1 choose a stage such as Pre-Engineering or Pre-Science. The final department comes later.
yc_need_department: Choose your department from the list.
adm_year_choice_on: On: a student who signs in with a slip chooses year 1 to 5 once, and the choice is trusted. You can correct it in Users & roles.
adm_year_choice_off: Off: everyone who signs in with a slip is a first-year student and cannot choose.
qa_anonymous_hint: The counselor sees only the nickname you type below, never your name or account. Untick it if you want the counselor to know who you are.
qa_email_me: Email me when it is answered
qa_email_me_hint: The email goes only to you and never contains your question or the answer; you read those in your private inbox.
ev_audience_hint: Leave everything empty for everyone. Otherwise only the matching students are told, listed for attendance and see the event.
ev_aud_no_departments: No departments in the list yet.
att_err_not_today: Scanning works only on the class day itself. For a past day use Mark attendance.
att_future_day: This class day is still in the future: attendance can be marked on the day or after it.
att_past_day: A past day: tick the students below. Scanning works only on the day itself.
